shop.schema.v1.IgnoreCoverage.jsonschema.description:
IgnoreCoverage has rules that are skipped for the zero value, and a field
 that is never validated.

^(never_checked)$.description: Never validated. protovalidate rejects IGNORE_ALWAYS next to other rules.

codes.description:
An empty value is valid; any other must have three characters.
 Upstream reads ignore on the field only, not under map.values.

email.description: "" is valid; any other value must be an email address.

ids.description: An empty element is valid; any other must be a UUID.

neverChecked.description: Never validated. protovalidate rejects IGNORE_ALWAYS next to other rules.

threshold.description: 0 is valid; any other value must exceed 5.

shop.schema.v1.IgnoreCoverage.jsonschema.title: Ignore Coverage
